exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) categories
outcome: relative contribution of each Robson group to the cesarean section rate
cohort: The study included all women who gave birth through lower segment cesarean section at Sheikh Zayed Hospital Rahim Yar Khan between January 2021 and July 2022.
finding: Out of 2950 cesarean sections, Robson TGCS class 5 was the largest contributor (39.6%), followed by 2b (11.2%), 2a (10.4%), and class 1 (9.7%).
mod_finding: The study found that Robson TGCS Class 5 was the largest contributor to cesarean sections (39.6%), followed by classes 2b, 2a, and 1.
